options: ServiceNow's integration add-on, often separately licensed, that adds spokes and the generic REST step to Flow Designer
A replacement for Flow Designer itself
A free feature included in every ServiceNow edition with no licensing considerations
A standalone external monitoring tool unrelated to flows
questions.explain: IntegrationHub is similar in licensing terms to Performance Analytics — often a separately licensed add-on layered on top of the base platform.

options: A manually written Script step with custom HTTP code
A packaged, pre-built set of flow actions for one specific external system, such as the Microsoft Teams Spoke or Slack Spoke
A type of trigger that only fires on record deletion
A field type used only in the Service Catalog
questions.explain: Spokes are pre-built, system-specific action sets — you drop in a ready-made action instead of hand-building the integration.

questions.q: What does the generic REST step let you do that a spoke doesn't require?
options: Call any REST API by configuring method, endpoint URL, headers, body, and an authentication profile, even when no spoke exists for that system
Automatically generate a spoke for any system you name
Skip authentication entirely for all outbound calls
Replace the need for any trigger in a flow
questions.explain: The REST step is the generic fallback for integrating with systems that don't have a pre-built spoke.

questions.q: Without IntegrationHub, what is the typical way to call an external system from a flow?
options: It's impossible to call any external system from a flow without IntegrationHub
A Script step with hand-written code to build the HTTP request, handle auth, and parse the response
A REST step, since REST steps don't require IntegrationHub
A Slack Spoke, since spokes are included in every edition
questions.explain: Without IntegrationHub, the typical alternative is a Script step with custom code — exactly what IntegrationHub is meant to reduce.

questions.q: What does this chapter deliberately NOT cover in depth, per this lesson?
options: How to drop a REST step into a flow
What a spoke is
Deep REST API design, authentication schemes, and IntegrationHub's scripting surface, which belong to a later full course in this path
The value proposition of configuration over custom code
questions.explain: This chapter stays at the Flow-Designer-usage level; deep API/scripting material is reserved for the later 'ServiceNow IntegrationHub & REST APIs' course.
